method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in the act's own actors and terms, with regulative rules for the filing and payment duties, and a taxpayer seat layer built from it; written straight from the deposited text with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (parts not encoded answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Kansas Statutes online (Office of Revisor of Statutes, read 2026-10-20; 2025 session laws), K.S.A. 79-3220 to 79-32,276 as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ksa-79-32-individual-income-tax.txt and ksa-79-32-individual-credits-eitc-safesr-food.txt (retrieved 2026-10-19 UTC). No instrument brought in.

scope: K.S.A. 79-32,109(b); 79-32,110(a), (b) and 79-32,110b; 79-32,111c; 79-32,116; 79-32,117 (main modifications); 79-32,118 to 79-32,120; 79-32,121(a) and 79-32,121b(a), (b)(1); 79-32,128(b) as an input; 79-32,205; 79-32,263; 79-32,265; 79-3220(a); 79-3221(b), (c)(3); 79-3225. Not covered (asserted): years before 2025, married filing separately, the other-state credit, a 79-32,110c rate reduction, the disabled veteran exemption. Read with subjects/us/internal-revenue-code-of-1986/ for the federal inputs.
seat: the individual taxpayer (resident or nonresident; single, joint or head of household)
